categoryName: Stationery & school supplies — notebooks, pens, pencils, geometry, art & craft, files, calculators, exam boards

skuLines.line: Single-line school exercise notebook (soft cover)
skuLines.examples: Classmate Soft Notebook 172/240 pages, Navneet Youva single line, Papergrid single line, Doms notebook
skuLines.packSizes: 76 / 92 / 144 / 172 / 240 pages; sold single and in bundles of 6-12
skuLines.seasonality: Huge spike Mar-Apr (new CBSE session) and Jul; steady replenishment through the year as copies fill up
skuLines.notes: Cheapest, heaviest, bulkiest line in the category — freight per rupee of value is worst here, so buy a full truck pre-session. Store off the floor and poly-wrapped: monsoon humidity at 173101 cockles and mildews paper. NIL GST since 22-Sep-2025.

skuLines.line: Four-line / double-line Hindi handwriting copy
skuLines.examples: Classmate four line, Navneet four line, Papergrid double line, local Hindi sulekh copy
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr session start; junior classes only
skuLines.notes: Junior-wing (Classes 1-5) staple; sells only in a school-attached store, so demand is fully predictable off the enrolment count.

skuLines.line: Gurmukhi / Punjabi four-line writing copy and Punjabi sulekh book
skuLines.examples: Navneet Punjabi copy, Malhotra / Punjab-local publisher sulekh, Gurmukhi varnamala practice book
skuLines.notes: HIGH-CONVICTION LOCAL LINE: Akal Academy is a Sikh institution teaching Punjabi, and Gurmukhi-ruled copies are NOT stocked by BigBasket/Blinkit/DMart. Source from Ludhiana/Jalandhar wholesalers, not a national FMCG-style distributor. If ARY does not carry it, a whole class's wallet leaks to a trip to town.

skuLines.line: Square / maths-ruled notebook
skuLines.examples: Classmate square line, Navneet maths square, local 1 cm square copy
skuLines.notes: Two rulings needed (large square for juniors, small square for seniors) — one SKU will not cover the school.

skuLines.line: Unruled / plain notebook and drawing notebook
skuLines.examples: Camlin Drawing Book, Classmate unruled, Navneet drawing book, Doms drawing book
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr plus art-exam and annual-function months
skuLines.notes: Cover both cheap 90 gsm and a 120 gsm cartridge version — the art teacher's list usually specifies gsm.

skuLines.line: Long book / hard-bound long notebook (register format)
skuLines.examples: Classmate Long Book, Camlin Long Book, Navneet long book, local 2-quire long book
skuLines.notes: Senior school and Eternal University lecture standard; heaviest per unit, so pair the order with the exercise-book truck.

skuLines.line: Spiral notebook, multi-subject A4 (2/3/5 subject)
skuLines.examples: Classmate Spiral 5-Subject 300 pages, Navneet Youva spiral, Camlin Premio spiral
skuLines.notes: The college-age upgrade from the single-subject copy; a national trend replacing several thin copies with one spiral.

skuLines.line: Practical / record book (one side ruled, one side plain)
skuLines.examples: Classmate Practical Record Book A4 132 pages, Navneet practical, local physics/chemistry/biology record book
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug and again 4-6 weeks before practical exams (Dec-Jan, Feb-Mar) — a panic-buy peak
skuLines.notes: Science-stream and university lab requirement. Under-stocking this in Jan is the classic campus-store failure: 200 students need it in the same week and there is no alternative shop.

skuLines.line: Graph book and loose graph sheets (1/4in, 1/8in, 1mm)
skuLines.examples: Camlin Graph Book, Sundaram graph book 96 pages, loose 1 mm graph sheets, semi-log / log-log sheets
skuLines.packSizes: Books 40-96 pages; loose sheets in pads of 20-50
skuLines.seasonality: Exam and practical season (Nov-Mar); physics/maths/engineering year-round
skuLines.notes: Loose sheets sold singly are a high-margin, high-footfall line. Engineering students also need semi-log/log-log — rarely stocked and reliably an off-campus trip when missing.

skuLines.line: Drawing / cartridge sheets, half & full imperial, 120-220 gsm
skuLines.examples: Camlin cartridge sheet, Brustro drawing sheet, generic half-imperial 140 gsm
skuLines.packSizes: Loose singles; packs of 10 / 20 / 25; A4, A3, half imperial, full imperial
skuLines.seasonality: Art competitions, annual function, engineering-drawing semesters
skuLines.notes: Sheets warp badly in monsoon damp and get creased in transit — store flat in a poly-wrapped box, never rolled or on a wall. Engineering drawing needs the full-imperial size specifically.

skuLines.line: Chart paper, colour chart paper and poster sheets
skuLines.examples: White chart paper, fluorescent/colour chart, black chart, sunboard sheet, ivory sheet
skuLines.seasonality: Project weeks, science exhibition, Gurpurab/annual-function decoration, election/notice boards
skuLines.notes: Bulky and easily damaged; keep flat. Very high attach rate with glue, sketch pens and thermocol — merchandise them together as a 'project corner'.

skuLines.line: A4 copier paper, 75 gsm ream
skuLines.examples: JK Copier A4 75 gsm 500 sheets, Century Bond, BILT Copy Power, JK Easy Copier
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peaks at exam paper-setting and admission season
skuLines.notes: Low margin but it is the anchor for institutional/departmental billing and for the photocopy service. Buy by the box. Damp reams jam every photocopier on campus — this is the one line where hill humidity costs real money.

skuLines.line: Ruled loose sheets / project sheets / A4 writing pad
skuLines.examples: A4 ruled project sheets, punched file paper, Camlin writing pad, one-side ruled project sheet
skuLines.packSizes: Pads of 50/100; loose sheets by the 100
skuLines.notes: Sold loose by the sheet at the counter; the classic small-town-store margin line.

skuLines.line: Sticky notes, memo pads and index/page flags
skuLines.examples: 3M Post-it 3x3, Oddy sticky notes, Solo memo cube, page-marker flags
skuLines.packSizes: 100-sheet pads, sets of 4-5 colours, cube of 400
skuLines.notes: Glue on sticky notes fails in prolonged damp — rotate stock, don't hold 12 months of cover.

skuLines.line: Diary, academic planner and daily journal
skuLines.examples: Nightingale diary, Rajhans diary, Classmate journal, dated 2027 academic diary
skuLines.packSizes: A5 / B5 / pocket; dated and undated
skuLines.seasonality: Dec-Jan for dated diaries (dead stock after Feb); undated journals year-round
skuLines.notes: Dated diaries are the one line in this category that becomes worthless — buy tight, and never re-order in February. Gift-quality diaries also serve staff Gurpurab/New Year gifting.

skuLines.line: Bound register / attendance & accounts register
skuLines.examples: 2/4/6-quire bound register, Solo register, attendance register, cash/ledger register
skuLines.notes: Pure institutional line — school offices, hostel wardens, mess, university departments. Sells on internal requisition, not walk-in, so keep depth on the 2- and 4-quire only.

skuLines.line: Sketch book / art spiral book (cartridge paper)
skuLines.examples: Camlin Sketchbook, Brustro sketch book 140 gsm, Navneet sketch book
skuLines.seasonality: Art class, competitions, hobby demand year-round
skuLines.notes: Genuine hobby demand from residential teenagers with evening free time and nowhere to shop — under-served in a boarding context.

skuLines.line: Scrapbook, project book and tracing paper
skuLines.examples: Camlin Scrapbook, local scrapbook 32 sheets, tracing paper roll/sheets, butter paper
skuLines.packSizes: Scrapbook 24-40 sheets; tracing sheets in packs of 10-25
skuLines.notes: Tracing paper is an engineering-drawing requirement at the university, not just a school craft item.

skuLines.line: Mass ball pen, blue/black 0.7mm
skuLines.examples: Cello Finograph, Reynolds 045 Fine Carbure, Linc Ocean Gel, Montex Hi-Tecpoint
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; hard spike at exam season (Nov-Dec, Feb-Mar)
skuLines.notes: The single highest-frequency line in the category — a pen is bought impulse, and in a closed township there is no second shop. Never go out of stock on blue. Pens are taxable (confirm the HSN 9608 rate before pricing — sources differ between 5% and 18% post-Sep-2025) unlike notebooks/pencils which are now nil.

skuLines.line: Gel pen / needle-tip pen, blue-black-red
skuLines.examples: Linc Pentonic, Cello Gripper, Flair Writo-Meter, Uni-ball Eye, Pilot V5
skuLines.seasonality: Board-exam months especially (black gel is the exam-hall preference)
skuLines.notes: Black gel demand spikes hard before CBSE boards. Stock the ₹10 Pentonic tier AND a ₹40-60 Uni-ball/Pilot tier — teenagers with pocket money trade up here.

skuLines.line: Erasable gel pen
skuLines.examples: Pilot Frixion, Flair erasable gel, Cello erasable
skuLines.packSizes: Single; set of 3 with eraser refill
skuLines.notes: One of the clearest 2025-26 trends in Indian stationery. Small facing, high aspiration value for a 12-18 cohort that sees it online but cannot buy it locally.

skuLines.line: Pen refills matched to bestsellers
skuLines.examples: Reynolds 045 refill, Cello Finograph refill, Linc Pentonic refill, Parker Vector refill
skuLines.notes: Refills must map exactly to the pens on the shelf — a mismatched refill wall is dead stock. Cheap, light, ideal for hill freight.

skuLines.line: Premium / executive pen and gift pen set
skuLines.examples: Parker Vector, Pilot V-Ball, Reynolds Trimax, Cello Signature, boxed pen+diary set
skuLines.seasonality: Farewells, teachers' day, convocation, Gurpurab and Diwali gifting, retirement
skuLines.notes: Small but genuinely profitable: a campus with 5,000 residents runs constant farewells and felicitations, and there is nowhere else on the hill to buy a presentable gift pen.

skuLines.line: Fountain pen with ink cartridges and ink bottle
skuLines.examples: Camlin fountain pen, Hero, Pilot 78G, Camlin fountain-pen ink bottle, Chelpark ink
skuLines.packSizes: Pen single; cartridge pack of 5-10; ink bottle 30-60 ml
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; middle-wing classes where cursive/fountain pen is mandated
skuLines.notes: Many CBSE schools still mandate fountain pen in Classes 3-6. Ink bottles are a leak/spill risk on a 30-50 km hill road — pack upright in a partitioned carton.

skuLines.line: Graphite writing pencil, HB
skuLines.examples: Nataraj 621, Apsara Platinum, Doms Zoom / Doms X1, Camlin Flora
skuLines.packSizes: Loose single; pack of 10; jar of 50-100; class pack
skuLines.notes: NIL GST since 22-Sep-2025. Highest-volume unit in the whole category for a 5-18 school. Also the natural line for a 'kit' bundle. Doms' North-India distribution (~33% of its mix) makes it easy to source alongside Camlin.

skuLines.line: Drawing pencil grade set (6H-6B) and charcoal pencil
skuLines.examples: Camlin drawing pencil set, Doms grade pencils, Faber-Castell 9000, Camlin charcoal pencil
skuLines.seasonality: Art exams, engineering drawing semesters, hobby year-round
skuLines.notes: Engineering drawing needs H/2H specifically; art class needs 2B-6B. Stock both ends or half the demand walks.

skuLines.line: Mechanical pencil and lead refills (0.5 / 0.7 mm)
skuLines.examples: Doms mechanical pencil, Camlin mechanical pencil, Faber-Castell Apollo, lead tubes 0.5/0.7 HB
skuLines.packSizes: Pencil single or blister of 2; lead tube of 30-40 leads
skuLines.notes: Lead tubes are the repeat-purchase engine; stock 0.5 and 0.7 in HB and 2B.

skuLines.line: Eraser — dust-free and standard
skuLines.examples: Apsara Non-Dust, Doms eraser, Nataraj eraser, Faber-Castell dust-free
skuLines.notes: NIL GST since 22-Sep-2025. Tiny, light, high-frequency, hard to run out of profitably — carry deep cover.

skuLines.line: Sharpener — single/double hole and canister
skuLines.examples: Apsara sharpener, Doms Groovy, Nataraj sharpener, Camlin canister sharpener
skuLines.notes: NIL GST since 22-Sep-2025. Canister type sells better in a residential school — no shavings on the hostel floor, and wardens ask for it.

skuLines.line: Geometry / instrument box (compass, divider, set squares, protractor, scale)
skuLines.examples: Camlin Kokuyo geometry box, Doms geometry box, Nataraj instrument box, Win geometry set
skuLines.packSizes: Standard box; jumbo box; metal and plastic
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr session start (Class 6+ mandated) and replacement through the year
skuLines.notes: A one-off-per-student purchase with a hard, dateable spike — a stockout in the first fortnight of the session sends a whole class to town. Compass points bend in transit; buy boxed, not loose.

skuLines.line: Loose scale/ruler, set square, protractor, drafting kit
skuLines.examples: Camlin 15 cm & 30 cm scale, Doms steel scale, set square pair, 180° protractor, Camlin technical instruments
skuLines.packSizes: Single; pair; 30 cm and 15 cm; plastic and steel
skuLines.notes: Replacement demand (scales snap constantly in a hostel) makes loose singles better business than only selling the boxed set. Engineering students additionally need a mini-drafter/T-square and a drawing board — a small, high-value university line.

skuLines.line: Exam pad / examination clipboard
skuLines.examples: Camlin exam pad, Faber-Castell exam pad (MDF, anti-rust clip), Solo exam board, wooden exam pad
skuLines.packSizes: A4 single; wood/MDF and plastic variants
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp spikes Nov-Dec (pre-boards, semester exams) and Feb-Mar (boards, finals)
skuLines.notes: CRITICAL for this specific site: a campus that runs school boards AND university semester exams sits every candidate on an exam pad, and demand arrives in one week. Wooden/MDF pads swell and delaminate in monsoon damp — keep them off the floor and shrink-wrapped.

skuLines.line: Non-programmable scientific calculator
skuLines.examples: Casio fx-991ES Plus 2nd Ed, Casio fx-82MS, Casio fx-991CW ClassWiz, Orpat scientific
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug (new engineering/science intake) and Jan semester; exam months
skuLines.notes: Verified price point Jul-2026: fx-991ES Plus 2nd Ed around ₹1,525 online, fx-991MS Plus around ₹1,120. It must be NON-PROGRAMMABLE — universities allow the fx-991 family but some exam bodies bar specific models, so stock the mainstream fx-82MS/fx-991ES rather than exotic ones. Highest-ticket item in the category: keep 2-3 units, not 20.

skuLines.line: Basic desktop / pocket calculator, 12-digit
skuLines.examples: Casio MJ-12, Orpat OT-512GT, Citizen desktop calculator
skuLines.notes: Office, mess, hostel-accounts and the ARY counters themselves. Also keep AA/button cells for it (may sit in another lane).

skuLines.line: Highlighter set
skuLines.examples: Camlin highlighter, Faber-Castell Textliner, Luxor highlighter, Doms highlighter
skuLines.notes: Dries out on the shelf — do not hold more than 6 months' cover, especially the pastel sets.

skuLines.line: Permanent / CD / fine-tip marker
skuLines.examples: Luxor permanent marker, Camlin permanent marker, Camlin OHP/CD marker
skuLines.packSizes: Single; set of 4-8; refill ink 15-20 ml
skuLines.notes: Boarding-school policy point worth raising with the school: solvent-based markers and whiteners are commonly restricted for under-18 residents. Confirm the institution's line before merchandising them at kid height.

skuLines.line: Whiteboard marker, refill ink and duster
skuLines.examples: Camlin whiteboard marker + ink, Luxor whiteboard marker, Camlin whiteboard duster
skuLines.packSizes: Single; set of 4 colours; refill ink 15-20 ml; duster single
skuLines.notes: Institutional workhorse — hundreds of classrooms across the academy and the university. Refill ink is far better business than replacement markers and much cheaper to freight; push the refill.

skuLines.line: Chalk (dustless white + coloured) and blackboard duster
skuLines.examples: Camlin dustless chalk, Apsara chalk, local white chalk box of 100
skuLines.notes: Older blocks on a large campus still run blackboards. Chalk absorbs damp and crumbles — small, frequent orders beat one monsoon-season bulk buy.

skuLines.line: Correction pen / whitener / correction tape
skuLines.examples: Camlin whitener pen, Kores whitener, Faber-Castell correction tape, Doms correction pen
skuLines.notes: Solvent-based whitener is the item most often restricted for minors in residential schools; correction TAPE is the safe substitute and should be the front-facing SKU here.

skuLines.line: Sketch pens / colour marker set
skuLines.examples: Doms sketch pens 12/24, Camlin sketch pens, Faber-Castell connector pens
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr, project weeks, art competitions, and gifting
skuLines.marginBand: 12-22% (art supplies are a thin-margin block in Indian retail)
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families with small children buy these outside the school list too — the only art-supply source within 30-50 km.

skuLines.line: Wax / plastic crayons
skuLines.examples: Doms crayons 12/24, Camlin wax crayons, Faber-Castell crayons, Camlin child-grip crayons
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr; year-round for toddlers of staff families
skuLines.notes: NIL GST since 22-Sep-2025 (crayons and pastels). Jumbo child-grip crayons serve the staff families' pre-schoolers, a cohort a school-list-only assortment misses entirely. Crayons soften and fuse in a hot store room — keep out of direct sun.

skuLines.line: Oil pastels
skuLines.examples: Camel (Kokuyo Camlin) Oil Pastels 25/50 shades, Doms oil pastels
skuLines.seasonality: Art class, inter-house competitions, annual exhibition
skuLines.notes: Camel 25-shade plastic pack is the de-facto CBSE art-class standard; stock that specific pack depth before any premium alternative.

skuLines.line: Colour pencils (half and full size)
skuLines.examples: Doms colour pencils 12/24, Apsara colour pencils, Faber-Castell 24 shades, Camlin HD colour pencils
skuLines.notes: Half-size 12-shade is the junior list item; full-size 24 is the senior/art one. Both, or half the school list goes unmet.

skuLines.line: Water colours, poster colours, acrylic and brushes
skuLines.examples: Camel water colour cakes 12, Camel Poster Colour 10 ml x 12, Camel Students' Oil Colour 9 ml x 12 (~₹270), Camlin brush set, palette
skuLines.packSizes: Cake set of 12; tubes 10 ml x 6/12; brush set of 5-7; palette single
skuLines.seasonality: Art exams, exhibitions, annual function backdrop painting
skuLines.notes: Tubes and bottles are a leak risk on hill transport and dry out if held too long — buy in sets, hold 4-6 months of cover, not a year.

skuLines.line: Craft materials — glitter, craft paper, foam sheet, thermocol, pipe cleaners, googly eyes
skuLines.examples: Glitter tubes, origami/colour paper pack, A4 foam sheets, thermocol sheets and balls, craft kits
skuLines.packSizes: Paper pack of 50-100 sheets; glitter 10 g tubes; foam sheets in 10s
skuLines.seasonality: Project weeks, science exhibition, Gurpurab/Diwali/annual-function decoration, rakhi and card-making
skuLines.marginBand: 30-50% (loose craft is the best-margin block in this category)
skuLines.notes: Thermocol is bulky/low-density — worst freight-per-rupee item here; buy it once a year with the notebook truck or source from Nahan/Solan. Highest impulse margin in the lane; merchandise beside chart paper and glue.

skuLines.line: Pencil pouch, pencil box and geometry pouch
skuLines.examples: Doms pencil box, Camlin writing kit, character/licensed pencil box, zip cloth pouch
skuLines.packSizes: Single; single- and double-decker boxes; cloth pouch
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr session start; birthday-gift demand year-round
skuLines.notes: Also the campus's default children's birthday gift — there is no toy or gift shop for 30-50 km. Sits on the boundary with the bags/school-needs lane; the pouch and box belong here, the school bag does not.

skuLines.line: Files and folders — box file, ring binder, clip file, display book, punched pockets
skuLines.examples: Solo box file, Solo ring binder, Oddy display book 20/40 pockets, Worldone clip file, plastic L-folder
skuLines.packSizes: Single; pack of 10 punched pockets; A4 and FS
skuLines.notes: Institutional volume line for offices, hostel wardens and departments; also the university student's assignment folder. Light and stackable — good freight economics.

skuLines.line: Project file, report cover, spring file, tags and laces
skuLines.examples: Spiral project file, transparent report cover, spring/laced file, board file with tags
skuLines.seasonality: Assignment and project submission windows — very sharp, week-long peaks
skuLines.notes: Pairs directly with the binding/photocopy service: a student buying a report cover usually needs spiral binding in the same visit. Stock ahead of submission dates, not after.

skuLines.line: Stapler, staple pins and pin remover
skuLines.examples: Kangaro HD-10 / No. 10, Kangaro DS-45, staple pins 10 and 24/6, Kangaro pin remover
skuLines.packSizes: Stapler single; pins box of 1,000; pack of 10 boxes
skuLines.notes: Two sizes only (No. 10 for handheld, 24/6 for office HD) covers 95% of demand; anything else is dead stock.

skuLines.line: Punch machine, clips, pins, rubber bands
skuLines.examples: Kangaro punch DP-480/600, paper clips 33 mm, binder clips 19/25/32 mm, U-pins, rubber bands
skuLines.packSizes: Punch single; clips box of 100; bands 100 g/500 g pouch
skuLines.notes: Rubber bands perish in damp heat; buy small. Steel clips rust in monsoon — keep boxed, not in open trays.

skuLines.line: Scissors, paper cutter and blades
skuLines.examples: Kangaro scissors, school safety scissors (round tip), Camlin paper cutter, cutter blade pack
skuLines.notes: Age control matters here: stock round-tip safety scissors for the junior wing and keep utility-blade cutters behind the counter in a store serving 5-18 residential children. Confirm the institution's policy before open display.

skuLines.line: Adhesives — glue stick, white glue, gum bottle, glue gun
skuLines.examples: Fevistik glue stick, Fevicol MR / Camlin white glue, Camlin gum bottle, Fevigum, glue gun + sticks
skuLines.packSizes: Glue stick 8/15/25 g; white glue 50 g-1 kg; gum 30-150 ml; glue gun single + stick packs
skuLines.notes: Named a 'daily mover' alongside pens, notebooks, pencils and A4 paper. Glue sticks dry out and gum bottles leak in transit — pack upright and rotate FIFO strictly.

skuLines.line: Tapes — cellophane, masking, double-sided, packing, plus dispenser
skuLines.examples: Cello tape 1/2in & 2in, 3M masking tape, double-sided tape, brown packing tape, tape dispenser
skuLines.notes: Also consumed by ARY's own counters and by hostels for notice boards. Adhesive fails after long damp storage — 6 months' cover maximum.

skuLines.line: Stamp pad, stamp ink and self-inking stamps
skuLines.examples: Camlin stamp pad + ink, Faber-Castell stamp pad, self-inking date stamp, numbering machine
skuLines.notes: Every office, hostel and department on a 5,000-person campus runs stamps; small, steady, never urgent.

skuLines.line: Envelopes and mailing supplies
skuLines.examples: White DL/A4 envelopes, brown cloth-lined envelope, A4 laminated envelope, courier bags
skuLines.notes: Large brown/cloth-lined envelopes for mark sheets and certificates are the institutional shape here, not the small white DL.

skuLines.line: Wall charts, educational posters, maps and globes
skuLines.examples: Alphabet/number charts, Gurmukhi varnamala chart, India & world political maps, table globe, human-body charts
skuLines.notes: NIL GST on maps and globes since 22-Sep-2025. Charts are the cheapest way to serve staff families teaching toddlers at home; a Gurmukhi varnamala chart is a local-fit line no national retailer stocks.

skuLines.line: Desk accessories — pen stand, desk organiser, book ends, reading stand, table mat
skuLines.examples: Solo pen stand, plastic desk organiser, metal book ends, wooden book/reading stand
skuLines.notes: Hostel move-in week (Jul-Aug, and Apr for the school) is the whole year's demand for this line — a reading stand is a genuine boarding-student want with no local source.

skuLines.line: ID card holder, lanyard and name badge
skuLines.examples: Plastic ID holder, printed lanyard, clip badge, name plate
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; event and convocation weeks
skuLines.notes: A closed 5,000-person institution issues and re-issues ID cards constantly; broken holders are a steady, tiny-ticket, very-high-margin repeat.

skuLines.line: Lamination pouches, binding combs and spiral coils
skuLines.examples: A4/ID lamination pouches 125 micron, plastic spiral binding combs 6-25 mm, transparent binding sheets
skuLines.packSizes: Pouches pack of 100; combs pack of 25/100
skuLines.notes: Not a walk-in retail line so much as the input to the lamination/binding service — which is where the real margin is. Buy in bulk packs, sell as a per-piece service.

skuLines.line: Pre-packed class-wise stationery kit (against the school's own supply list)
skuLines.examples: Class 1-2 kit, Class 6-8 kit, Class 9-10 kit, engineering-first-year drawing kit; built from Doms/Camlin/Classmate lines
skuLines.packSizes: One kit per student, bagged and labelled by class
skuLines.seasonality: One enormous Mar-Apr peak (school) and Jul-Aug (university)
skuLines.marginBand: 20-30% blended, with better mix than selling the same items loose
skuLines.notes: The single biggest operational idea in this lane for a captive campus: get the school's official supply list per class, pre-pack, and sell one SKU to a parent instead of 14 line items. Converts the March scramble into a planned build, cuts stockouts, and locks the spend on campus.

trends2026: GST 2.0 (56th Council, effective 22-Sep-2025) moved exercise books, notebooks, pencils, crayons, pastels, erasers, sharpeners, maps and globes to NIL GST — sharper MRPs on the core school basket and a real shift of share from loose/unbranded to branded. Pens stayed taxable (confirm the HSN 9608 rate before pricing; sources disagree between 5% and 18%).

Erasable gel pens (Pilot Frixion, Flair, Cello) have gone from novelty to a named mainstream trend in India, with price points now reaching ₹40-80 — the biggest new-format opportunity in writing instruments.

Quick commerce turned stationery into a genuine category: Blinkit's stationery business is reported at ₹500 Cr+ and is one of q-commerce's fastest-growing non-grocery lines. It has reset the expectation that a pen or an exam pad is available in minutes — which in a closed township only a well-stocked campus store can honour.

Aesthetic/kawaii/pastel stationery and character licensing are driving premiumisation in the 12-25 cohort — the exact age band that makes up most of Baru Sahib's residents, and the cohort most exposed to the trend online while having no local place to buy it.
Sustainability moving from claim to spec: recycled-paper notebooks, bamboo and recycled-paper pens, and plastic-free packaging are increasingly written into institutional and school tenders.

Value transformation over volume growth in the Indian pen market — volume from the education base is flat-to-steady while value shifts up to gel, rollerball and fountain pens, so the same student count spends more per pen year on year.

DOMS' distribution build-out (5,675+ distributors, ~1.45 lakh retailers in FY24-25, North India ~33% of its sales mix) has made Doms a credible full-range second brand to Camlin/Classmate for a North-India hill retailer, improving both fill rate and negotiating position.

Multi-subject spiral notebooks, dot-grid and bullet-journal formats are displacing the stack of thin single-subject copies at college level; smart/hybrid notebooks remain niche in India but are visible in the premium tier.
adjacentServices: Photocopy and printing (B/W and colour) — the single highest-attach service for a campus stationery counter, and the reason to carry A4 paper at thin margin
Spiral, comb and soft binding of project files, practical files, assignments and theses — sells directly off the report-cover and project-file lines
Lamination — ID cards, certificates, charts, notice-board material
Passport-size photographs and photo printing (admission forms, exam forms, ID cards for a 5,000-person institution)
Scan-and-email, online form filling and fee/exam-form payment help — a real service in a township 30-50 km from a market town
Prescribed textbook, guide and reference-book stocking, plus a second-hand book exchange at session end
Pre-packed class-wise stationery kits sold against the school's official supply list, ordered in advance and collected at the hostel

Institutional indent supply to school offices, hostels, university departments and the mess on internal requisition with monthly billing (the B2B half of this category, usually bigger than the walk-in half)
Name-labelling, embossing and marking of books, boxes and uniforms for hostel students
